description: The Bank of Khyber was established in 1991 through an Act passed by the Provincial Legislative Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and was awarded scheduled-bank status in September 1994. It is an A+ rated commercial bank operating across Pakistan through a network of more than 286 branches and sub-branches, with the provincial government as its major stakeholder, and it offers both conventional and Islamic banking.
headOffice: 24 - The Mall, Peshawar Cantt, 25000, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
